objective: Perform one real Windows-machine lifecycle acceptance of the released DSH Crew v0.3.1 using the user's stable dsh-crew checkout: preflight -> install -> status/integration verification -> uninstall without purge -> residual verification -> reinstall -> final status. Leave the machine in the installed state if and only if the full lifecycle passes.
context: @ran-sh/dsh-crew@0.3.1 is public and latest, v0.3.1 points exactly to dd414a352065e983e1be1b845287e99a50ade9c5, and the final release gate plus post-publish default npm install smoke passed. This task is specifically the user's requested real local Windows install/uninstall lifecycle verification. Use the stable repository checkout already on the user's machine rather than a disposable worktree for the actual setup.mjs install, because the supported source installer registers a link to its checkout path and the final installed state must not point to a temporary directory. Only Crew-owned ~/.config/dsh-crew state plus Crew-managed Codex/Claude integration entries may be touched. Do not print tokens, credentials, API keys, cookies, or secrets. Claude Code is optional: if its CLI is absent, record SKIP rather than failure; if present, its Crew integration must install/uninstall/reinstall correctly. Do not modify repository source files. Do not publish npm, mutate tags/Releases/branches, or change registry state.

npm publish, dist-tag mutation, unpublish/deprecate, or any registry write
git tag, GitHub Release, branch, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, force-push, or ref mutation
uninstall --purge or deletion of retained Crew config/backups unless required solely to recover from a task-created failed install and explicitly recorded
reading, hashing, enumerating, or mutating ~/.dsh, the official web profile, official DSH credentials/config stores, or unrelated user files
printing, copying, inspecting, or committing secrets, tokens, credentials, API keys, cookies, or private keys

Write schema-v2 Result Contract to docs/agent-results/TASK-V031-WINDOWS-LIFECYCLE-ACCEPTANCE-result.json with exact PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/SKIP evidence, including preflight state, first install/status, uninstall/status/residual audit, reinstall/final status, and final installed-state verdict.

acceptance_criteria: The current stable checkout is proven product/install-equivalent to the immutable v0.3.1 target except for Agent Workflow task/result bookkeeping before any local mutation.
First real install succeeds on the user's Windows machine and status reports the dedicated Crew DSH plugin and Codex integration installed; Claude is PASS if present or SKIP if absent.

Second install succeeds from the same stable checkout and final status again reports the expected installed state.
The final Crew profile registration points to the stable repository checkout, not a disposable path, and package/runtime identity is 0.3.1.
No official ~/.dsh or web-profile state is read or modified, no secrets are exposed, no unrelated integration is changed, and no repository product file is modified.
